img.caption: Fig 7: Ablation studies. Left: k_max=1 is optimal—expanding auxiliary intents beyond the top-1 degrades set IoU. Middle: fusion weight alpha=0.1 minimises ECE on both single- and multi-intent data; either pure retrieval or pure LLM confidence miscalibrates. Right: retrieval pool K_r=1 yields the best set IoU, confirming that top-1 retrieval suffices with LLM re-ranking.
